full_page.content:
c. 1939
The following is a faithful transcription of a message on the flyleaf of one of the Volumes of the Mystical City of God handwritten by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey O.F.M.Cap.
Dear Reader :-
"To know is to Appreciate"
Trees are known by their fruits - -
Artists may be known by their master-pieces
God Himself can be appreciated - loved - only inasmuch as He is known.
The following pages offer a practical Introduction to God's most outstanding masterpiece - His own Virgin Mother Mary Immaculate.
Studying Mary's life ... is learning to love ... God in His works - His Masterpiece.
Fr. Solanus O.M. Cap.
Original in possession of: Marie Mercier Gardiner 2529 Coolidge Rd. Troy, Mich. 48084
